page.layout: One title page. Top: a faint line of Greek or Hebrew, mostly show-through, and a second faint line. Centre: a Hebrew motto in two lines, then a Latin motto in two lines, all in bold black type. Below: three faint columns of short lines (left, centre, right), largely show-through and not legible. Bottom left: a faint numeral. Right margin: a bold "A B" mark.

main_text.l: Devolve super Jehovam viam tuam, & spera

page.notes: The Hebrew is Psalm 37:5 as printed, transcribed from a degraded scan. The niqqud and some letters may be wrong. The Latin motto is clear. The Latin "Jehovam" follows the J spelling of the scan. The faint lines in the three columns below the motto are show-through or very worn print and could not be read; they are marked as illegible with approximate letter counts. The bold "A B" in the right margin is a gathering mark, not transcribed as text, and the faint numeral at the bottom left is unreadable. No page number, running head or catchword is visible.
